Which statements about noble gases are correct?
1
Their atoms have complete outer shells of electrons.
2
They exist as diatomic molecules.
3
They are in Group VIII of the Periodic Table.
4
They react with oxygen to give an acidic oxide.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
